ctor.rationale: `base(0, CardType.Attack, CardRarity.Common, TargetType.AnyEnemy)` (Anger.cs:16-19) == cost 0 / ATTACK / COMMON / ANY_ENEMY. No keywords, no tags on either side.

CanonicalVars.rationale: `new DamageVar(6m, ValueProp.Move)` (Anger.cs:14) == `_damage = 6` dealt through `DamageCmd.deal(..., card=self)`, whose default props are `DamageProps.CARD == ValueProp.MOVE` (valueprops.py:34). Powered (no Unpowered), so this card is NOT in gap G1's blast radius and IS boosted by Strength/Vulnerable/Weak on both sides.

OnPlay.issue: The damage half is faithful (`DamageCmd.Attack(DynamicVars.Damage.BaseValue).FromCard(this).Targeting(cardPlay.Target)`, Anger.cs:24-26, == `DamageCmd.deal(ctx.hooks, ctx.resolve_target(target_idx), self._damage, dealer=ctx.player, card=self)`), and the destination pile is faithful (`CardPileCmd.AddGeneratedCardToCombat(card, PileType.Discard, Owner)`, Anger.cs:28, == `CardPileCmd.add_to_discard`, cmds.py:464-472, which appends and runs `_enter_combat`). THE COPY IS NOT A CLONE. C# `CreateClone()` (Anger.cs:27 -> CardModel.cs:2168-2181 -> RunState.CloneCard:394-399 -> AbstractModel.MutableClone:162-169) is a MemberwiseClone plus `CardModel.DeepCloneFields` (CardModel.cs:1193-1216), which carries over the live keyword set, the cloned `_energyCost` object (so `SetThisCombat` / `AddThisTurn` / free-this-turn overrides survive), `base_replay_count`, AND deep-clones the card's Enchantment (1204-1209) and Affliction (1210-1214) onto the copy. The sim instead constructs a bare `AngerCard()` and replays `upgrade()` `upgrade_level` times (anger.py:36-38), so the copy loses the enchantment, the affliction, and every cost override. Observable: play a Spiral-enchanted Anger -- in the game the discarded copy is also Spiral-enchanted and replays when played; in the sim the copy is vanilla. LIVE: `enchantments.py:372-375` (Spiral) accepts any ATTACK card, and `events/spiraling_whirlpool.py:46` attaches it to a player-chosen deck card; `events/self_help_book.py:71` and `events/grave_of_the_forgotten.py:47` are two more ported attach sites. RATIONALE CITES THIRD FILES (rule 7): CardModel.cs, RunState.cs, AbstractModel.cs, cmds.py, enchantments.py and the three event modules are not hashed by this record. Presentation, folded in: the generated card is wrapped in CardCmd.PreviewCardPileAdd(..., 2.2f) (Anger.cs:28), a pile-add tween with no state effect.

OnUpgrade.rationale: `DynamicVars.Damage.UpgradeValueBy(2m)` (Anger.cs:33) == `self._damage += 2` (6 -> 8). Downgrade-safe: `_init_vars` re-seeds `_damage`, and `card_probes.py downgrade` does not list anger.

guards.rationale: An AnyEnemy card always has a resolved target; the sim's `ctx.resolve_target(target_idx)` is the same contract. No behavioural branch.
